description.zh: 修改模式：Cover（覆盖）/Append（追加）/Delete（删除）
description.en:
The modification mode. Valid values:
- Cover: overwrites the existing whitelist.
- Append: appends entries to the existing whitelist.
- Delete: deletes entries from the existing whitelist.

description.zh: IP白名单列表，多个用逗号分隔
description.en: The IP whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

title.zh: 修改 Supabase IP 白名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx modify-supabase-security-ip-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxsp-000000000 --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1,192.168.0.0 --group-name default --modify-mode Append --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardbx ModifySupabaseSecurityIPList --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName default --SecurityIPList '127.0.0.1,192.168.0.0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ModifyMode Append --DBInstanceName 'pxsp-000000000'
